summary: Complete architecture and database design implementation plan for TaskFlow, an enterprise-grade MERN Task Management and Collaborative Kanban Platform. Details Step 1 (full-stack unified directory layout and server/client separation) and Step 2 (production MongoDB/Mongoose schemas for Users, Workspaces, Boards, Columns, Tasks, and Activity Logs with JWT and RBAC), alongside frontend component hierarchy and RESTful API contract.
